## vtc/scene/graph clients take a concrete Option<&XFilter> in /query and /queryChanges; canonical mail and the other 6 clients take generic Option<&Filter<C>>
Crates: jmap-vtc-client, jmap-scene-client, jmap-graph-client (canonical: jmap-mail-client)
Evidence: Canonical: crate-jmap-mail-client/src/methods/email.rs:269-271 `email_query<C: Serialize>(.., filter: Option<&Filter<C>>, ..)`. The same generic shape is in chat, calendars, contacts, tasks, sharing and filenode (e.g. crate-jmap-tasks-client/src/methods/task.rs:255,321; crate-jmap-sharing-client/src/methods/principal.rs:235,304). Mark recorded the decision in commit 8827090e (feat(clients)!: generic Filter<C>, bd JMAP-1j9k.2): "every extension-client /query and /queryChanges takes Option<&jmap_types::query::Filter<C>> with C: Serialize", so callers can send WithMetadata<C> (draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-02 §3.5) or vendor conditions. The vtc, scene and graph clients were added after that decision (a61d984f 2026-10-20, 5de6a7fe and 1d1e11f2 2026-10-21) and use the concrete alias instead, on 18 signatures: crate-jmap-vtc-client/src/methods/vtc_call.rs:120,148; vtc_participant.rs:122,150; vtc_recording.rs:120,148; vtc_livestream.rs:122,150; crate-jmap-scene-client/src/methods/scene_asset.rs:121,149; scene_avatar.rs:122,150; scene_region.rs:121,149; scene_object.rs:121,149; crate-jmap-graph-client/src/methods/graph.rs:137,166. Graph/query is affected too, because Graph/query has no single-condition rule. The bare required `&GraphNodeFilterCondition` / `&GraphEdgeFilterCondition` / `&GraphNodeOpFilterCondition` on graph_node/graph_edge/graph_node_op_query is spec-mandated (draft-atwood-jmap-graph-00 L285, L314) and is NOT part of this finding. No bead covers it.
Why breaking later: Moving from `Option<&Filter<XCondition>>` to `Option<&Filter<C>>` breaks every caller that passes a bare `None`, because C can no longer be inferred (mail documents the `None::<&EmailFilter>` spelling for this reason). Keeping the concrete type freezes three crates out of the canonical shape and blocks WithMetadata<C> or custom conditions there.
Fix: Before 0.4, convert the 18 vtc/scene/graph /query and /queryChanges methods to `<C: Serialize>(.., filter: Option<&Filter<C>>, ..)` as in mail-client, and add the `None::<&XFilter>` doc line. Leave the spec-mandated required-condition graph_node/graph_edge/graph_node_op methods alone.
Size: S

Votes: REAL: I could not refute it. All three conditions hold at HEAD.

(a) The evidence holds. The public vtc/scene/graph /query and /queryChanges methods take concrete aliases. Examples: crate-jmap-vtc-client/src/methods/vtc_call.rs:120,148 take `Option<&VtcCallFilter>`, and crate-jmap-graph-client/src/methods/graph.rs:137,166 take `Option<&GraphFilter>`. The same holds for vtc_participant, vtc_recording, vtc_livestream and scene_asset, scene_avatar, scene_region, scene_object at the cited lines. The aliases are `Filter<XFilterCondition>`, at crate-jmap-vtc-types/src/query.rs:37 and crate-jmap-graph-types/src/query.rs:47.
